name: DataSpell
summary: JetBrains says anonymous usage statistics are off by default in release builds, but the data-sharing notice says non-commercial licenses collect analytics and detailed AI and code-related data by default. Data goes to JetBrains and is processed in the EU. I could not confirm the error-report default for DataSpell, so this rating uses the worst default.

optOut.instructions: Open Settings > Appearance & Behavior > System Settings > Data Sharing. Clear 'Send usage statistics' and the option for detailed data collection by JetBrains AI.
